def equation(t, x, v, params):
    st = np.sqrt(t)
    c = np.cos(params[8]*st + params[9])
    return (params[0] + params[1]*x + params[2]*x**3 + params[3]*v + params[4]*v**2
            + params[5]/v + params[6]*np.log(x) + (params[7] + params[1]*0)*c + params[2]*0 + params[3]*0 + 0*c)
